rotation.source_passage:
came in [...]
I said, "O lord, [...]
by the blessed [goddess]
I take no pleasure in being
above the earth; a longing
grips me to die
and see the dewy, lotus-
covered banks of Acheron [...]"

I have gone grey at the temples,
yes, and my head is white;
graceful youth has departed,
and my teeth are old.

Of sweet life now
little time is left.

And so I sob often,
fearing Tartarus:
the cellar of Hades is terrible,
and the descent painful,

and for one who goes down,
there is no way back.

Lord, with whom Love, the conqueror,
and blue-eyed Nymphs
and rosy Aphrodite
play together,
rotation.enantiomorph:
Signal in [...]
I said, "O ground control, [...]
by the steady beacon
I take no comfort in staying
below the sky; a pull
grips me to climb
and see the cold, star-
seeded shores of the far dark [...]"

I have burned clean my boosters,
yes, and my hull runs bright;
the easy orbit has slipped me,
and my fuel is thin.

Of banked thrust now
little store is left.

And so I hail often,
courting the horizon:
the throat of the well is fierce,
and the fall inward steep,

and for one who climbs out,
there is only the way back.

Ground, with whom Dawn, the returning,
and clear-eyed navigators
and patient home-lights
keep the watch,

beat_map: scene-setting entrance and invocation of the lord, culminating in a wish to descend and behold the far shore
catalogue of bodily decline (temples, head, youth, teeth)
confession of recurring dread and its named cause, with elaboration on the terror of the way down
the sealing law of one-directionality: no return for the one who descends
renewed address to the lord amid a train of playful companions

spatial_form.notes: six stanzas of uneven length (8,4,2,4,2,4); two 2-line stanzas function as pivots/seals; bracketed lacunae in source not reproduced as N is intact

coherence_axes: one-directional descent (from surface toward an irreversible below)
temporal depletion (grey/white/old marking a used-up measure)
invocation-frame bracketing a lament (a lord addressed at open and close)
layer_b_declaration.semantic_field: spacefaring / interstellar launch and event-horizon physics; the outbound crew and their radioed home

rotation.commentary: The source's gesture is foreclosed one-directionality: descent to Acheron/Tartarus for which "there is no way back." The MIRROR operator restores the directionality-axis's symmetry the source refused. N inverts the vector — ascent instead of descent, launch instead of burial — and at the seal-stanza (unit 5) enacts the mirror precisely: where the source seals "there is no way back," N seals "there is only the way back." The irreversibility becomes reversibility; the downward well becomes an outward climb whose sole outcome is return. The invocation-frame is preserved (lord → ground control) with the closing companion-catalogue rebuilt around a "returning" Dawn rather than a playful Love. Stanza geometry (8,4,2,4,2,4) is held exactly; the two-line pivots keep their pivot function. The wager the operator names — that what was launched outward returns — is made legible: the witness's "return on what was broken" is answered by inverting the very line that denied return. Semantic field (interstellar physics, radio, crew) is disjoint from the Anacreontic field (Hades, goddesses, aging body); the source cannot be reconstructed from the spacefaring surface.
